content.comment_body: Hello, I have some questions regarding upgrading [product_name] [version_no] on my PC. Is it necessary to install each intermediate update (from [version_no] to [version_no] to [version_no]), or can I proceed directly from [version_no] to [version_no]? Can I simply download the latest update available on the [company_name] website and install it directly, or do I need to use the previous update installation files? Please advise. Thank you.

You can install an upgrade onto any [product_name] version without installing previous updates. Afterwards, you can remove the older version. On a new computer, you only need the latest upgrade to perform a fresh install of [product_name]. You may be prompted to reference the original installation disc or its ISO image briefly during setup.

Hi [user_name], Thanks for your response. I tried a fresh install using only the [version_no] update without having [product_name] installed before. The installer did not ask me to insert the DVD for referencing the original installation CD or ISO. Is it normal if I'm not prompted for another DVD, or could this affect the performance or functionality of [product_name]? Please let me know. Thank you. Additional info: I performed this on a laptop running Windows 7 32-bit. Also, the same result occurred on a laptop with Windows 7 64-bit.

Hi [user_name], I also attempted the installation with only [version_no] on another laptop running Windows 7 64-bit. This time, I received a prompt to select the location for the previous installer. I've attached a screenshot of the message. Should I select the installer path for [version_no] or [version_no]? Please advise. Thank you.

The process is essentially the same for each version, though the folder to reference on the original installation DVD (not the demo version) may vary. Keep trying until successful. This resource should help you: [document]

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers around user uncertainty about the proper upgrade steps for [product_name], specifically moving from an earlier to a newer version. Users are unclear whether intermediate updates are needed or if direct upgrades are possible, and have questions about installer behavior when referencing previous versions. Their main concerns involve installation procedures, differences depending on system setups, and ensuring correct functionality after the upgrade. The conversation exposes gaps in clarity around the upgrade workflow and available support guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek a simple and direct upgrade process, with transparent instructions that avoid unnecessary prompts or intermediate steps. They want confirmation that their installation method will not lead to any performance or usability issues and hope that the product will operate reliably once upgraded.
